title: Chapter 1275
text:
Clap clap clap!

With Han Xiao taking the lead, the others could only suppress the shock in their hearts and clap along with him. They felt like they were witnessing history.

The true portrayal of their current mood was probably like being suddenly robbed by bandits while eating hotpot and singing. It was too f * cking "surprising"!

Seeing this, the dozens of revivors smiled and sat down. Some of the Primordial Ones saw Mael standing there dumbly and even kindly pulled him to sit with them.

The applause gradually stopped, and Han Xiao sat down again. He looked at Beiger and the others, smiled, and said, "Everyone, do you want to introduce yourselves?"

"I don't think there's a need." Beiger waved his hand and looked around. "If you want to know who we are, just look up history."

Everyone nodded subconsciously. The Primordial Ones were extremely famous, and almost every Beyond Grade A knew their names like the back of their hand. There was indeed no need to introduce them.

This time, Dylan raised his smooth, white chin slightly. "Although I'm not a Primordial One, there shouldn't be anyone here who doesn't know me, right?"

Everyone turned to look at him. Among the revivors, there were a few historical Beyond Grade As who were not Primordial Ones. Compared to them, they were not that famous, so there were quite a few who did not know Dylan.

"Who are you?" Sun Hunter was curious.

"Tsk, there's really someone who doesn't know me?" Dylan glanced at him. "Little thing, listen carefully. I'm the Elf King, Dylan. Go back and learn more about history. Don't ask such an ignorant question next time."

Sun Hunter was stunned for a moment before flying into a rage.

Do you know how to speak? How dare you call me little thing?

If not for the fact that my main body is not here, do you believe that I would've stuffed dozens of cannon barrels into your mouth and blown you to death!

On the other side, many Mages were shocked.

"So it's the famous' Elf King 'in the history of magic. It's said that you opened up a new path and created a special elven spell system. It has been passed down to this day and has become the mainstream spell system of the elves. Unfortunately, due to your sudden death, some profound secret techniques have been lost forever. I hope to have the chance to learn from you in the future."

Austin could not help but express his goodwill. A Mage's desire for spells was like a Mechanic's curiosity for technology.

Hearing this, Dylan lowered his head and scratched his nails. He pursed his lips and said, "It depends on my mood. I usually don't like to communicate with untalented mages, but if I'm in a good mood, it's not impossible to be lenient."

Austin's expression froze, and he shut his mouth in embarrassment. The other Mages who wanted to make friends with him also shut their mouths when they saw this. They did not want to be snubbed.

Seeing this, many people looked at Dillon in realization.

It turned out that this person's words were so strange. No wonder he died so miserably in history. He deserved it!

Seeing that the atmosphere had become a little strange, Beiger changed the topic and said with a smile, "I have to say, this association is quite well done. In our era, there was no such good environment. The person who established the association was really far-sighted and ambitious. I'm very impressed."

"I think so too." Han Xiao smiled.

Hearing that, everyone couldn't help but glance at Han Xiao, then at Beiger, whose expression didn't change.

You're still the same old man. This flattery is really strong. One dares to flatter, and the other dares to accept it.

Beiger turned to look at everyone and said kindly, "There's still a long way to go. I hope we can get closer."

Everyone nodded and responded. No one put on an arrogant expression. The Primordial Ones were the pioneers who had created a new era, so they still had the necessary respect.

The welcome party finally returned to its original purpose. The two groups of people communicated for a while, and the dozens of revivors integrated into the association. The original members of the association also composed themselves. No matter how unbelievable they found it, they had no choice but to accept the reality of the old people opening their coffins and rising.

Although they had accepted the revivors, everyone was still full of doubts. They were very curious about how Black Star had discovered the Sanctum Revival phenomenon, how he had persuaded the revivors to join the association, where the revivors had stayed in the past, and so on.

Han Xiao, on the other hand, acted calmly and skimmed over these questions without explaining.

Everyone's hearts were itching. Their impression of Han Xiao became even more mysterious, and their attitude toward him became more and more respectful. No one knew how much power Black Star still had hidden under the water. They only felt that it was unfathomable.

However, the more this was the case, the more relieved the members of the Beyond Grade A Association were. In the past, for the protection and resources of the association, everyone had obeyed the rules and listened to orders. Now, there was an even more important reason.

The Sanctum Revival gave everyone confidence. Originally, some people were still worried about the warning of the three Universal Civilizations, but now that their mentality had stabilized, their fear of the three Universal Civilizations instantly disappeared.

While everyone was chatting, Manison was silently watching from the side, his heart filled with shock.

"Black Star, so this is the trump card you prepared. Beautiful! The significance of the Sanctum Revival to us is extraordinary. Not only will it increase the confidence of the members to face risks, but it will also strengthen the cohesion of the association. The group will be unprecedentedly united.

Furthermore, reviving the past Beyond Grade As is another way to quickly replenish fresh blood. This is much more efficient than waiting for new Beyond Grade As. The strength of the association will expand in a short period of time and be reborn, breaking through the safety line set by the three Universal Civilizations. They will have to think twice before making a move … This way, I won't have to take the risk of releasing the artificial intelligence virus. "

Manison secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

He had always been worried that Black Star's peaceful path would become the basis for the three Universal Civilizations to make a move. He was worried that it would be difficult to shake the determination of the three Universal Civilizations with just Black Star's influence. However, it seemed that Black Star's response was completely out of his expectations. He was immediately relieved that he had such a trump card.

Manison had to admit that this move of Black Star's was much more effective than his Virus Deterrence plan, which was to kill a thousand enemies at the cost of eight hundred of his own men.

Although the two of them usually did not get along, he acknowledged Han Xiao's ability. At this moment, he felt relieved that he did not trust the wrong person.

On the other side, Kasuyi glanced at Han Xiao from time to time, finding him more and more pleasing to the eye.

Kasuyi was not ignorant about the Sanctum Revival. He was probably the only one present other than Han Xiao who knew that there was no limit to the number of times the Sanctum Revival could be used. He was more excited than anyone else.

He did not know why Han Xiao pretended that there was only one chance for the Sanctum Revival, but after thinking about it, he could guess the general intention. Naturally, he would not expose it on the spot.

At this moment, Kasuyi could not help but feel lucky.

Fortunately, I have a good relationship with Black Star and have not offended him. Also, it's fortunate that the companion I chose for the Celestial Star Alliance trip is Black Star. If it were anyone else, even if they knew about the existence of the Sanctums, they would probably be like me, clueless for decades … I wonder how Han Xiao mastered the Sanctum Revival.

Kasuyi did not know about the existence of the Holy Covenant organization. He thought that the trip to the secondary dimensions was the only inspiration Han Xiao had received. He secretly sighed that he had chosen the most reliable companion.

While most of the association members were pleasantly surprised and excited, only the direct members of the three Universal Civilizations had solemn expressions.

From a personal point of view, the Sanctum Revival was indeed a blessing for the Beyond Grade As. However, from the perspective of a civilization, the fact that the Beyond Grade A Association had this method was undoubtedly earth-shattering bad news for the direct members.

Beyond Grade As have an extra life. If we can't get rid of the unstable factors once and for all, it'll be troublesome. Even if we can get rid of them once, the dead will definitely become smarter after being revived and will hide in the dark to take revenge.

The core of the problem is Black Star. Only he has the method of the Sanctum Revival. Unless we kill him first or get the method of the Sanctum Revival from him, it's almost impossible to split the Beyond Grade A Association.

Many of the direct members frowned, and similar thoughts flashed through their minds.

They had more or less received news that the upper echelons of the civilizations were about to deal a substantial blow to the Beyond Grade A Association. At this juncture, Black Star had revealed his true intentions and deliberately revealed this method. In their eyes, it was undoubtedly a warning signal, wanting to use this move to intimidate the three Universal Civilizations so that they would not dare act rashly.

Furthermore, the high-end combatants of the association had suddenly soared by one-third. Even if the upper echelons of their own civilization wanted to make a move, they would have to consider the cost again.

For the sake of the entire Beyond Grade As, he did not hesitate to take on the pressure himself … This is not like Black Star's usual style.

Thinking of this, many direct members looked at Han Xiao meaningfully.

Han Xiao also noticed the gazes of these direct members. His face was calm, and he smiled in his heart.

The Calamity of the Supers was inevitable. Sooner or later, the conflict would erupt. Although he had now become the detonator of the Calamity of the Supers, his fundamental goal had never changed. One was to find a way to make the three Universal Civilizations hesitate and stabilize them. This way, he could control the intensity of the conflict between the Calamity of the Supers and preserve more strength to deal with the World Tree War that would come at any time.

Another goal was for his own sake. His position would only be more stable if he mixed well with the entire class.

I've finally taken this step. There's no turning back. I can only guide the torrent of the times and keep rushing forward …

All kinds of thoughts flashed through his mind. Han Xiao calmed himself down, clapped his hands, and interrupted everyone's conversation.

"Now that everyone knows each other, there will be plenty of opportunities to interact in the future. Let's end today's welcome party here. In the next regular meeting, we will discuss the allocation of resources and help these seniors build their forces."

Everyone nodded and had no objections.

With a large group of Beyond Grade As, a portion of the benefits would definitely be taken away. However, because of the existence of the Sanctum Revival, almost everyone had made the decision to deepen their relationship with Han Xiao. Han Xiao's authority in the association had already expanded to the extreme, and he basically meant what he said.

"Alright, let's end the meeting today."

Han Xiao smiled, directly deactivated the remote projection, and disappeared.

Seeing this, everyone dispersed with their own thoughts.

No matter what kind of feelings they had, everyone realized that from today onwards, the ecology of the Beyond Grade As had been rewritten. When what happened in this venue today spread out, the structure of the entire galactic society would be greatly impacted. A storm of change would definitely be set off from here and sweep across the entire universe!

The initiator was Black Star, who had not revealed himself for the past few decades and suddenly released a trump card!

The many Beyond Grade As had a vague feeling that Black Star, who they had pushed to the top, might very well be the beginning of a new era!

…

The content of this welcome party was not kept a secret. With the help of people with ulterior motives, the news spread faster than expected. The next day, it spread throughout the major Star Fields, and countless media outlets wrote all kinds of reports, competing to be the first to broadcast.

For a time, the news media channels in the major regions were all "Shocking! The return of the Primordial Ones! " "Truth or Lie? The truth of the Sanctum Revival! " "Shocking news from the Beyond Grade A Association. Where did the dozens of 'new Beyond Grade As' come from?" "Black Star: Welcome the return of the old era!" Such headlines.

Who knew how many galactic residents and galactic organizations saw this news, and their first reaction was disbelief, thinking that this was false information.

The Sanctum Revival could revive dead Beyond Grade As? The Primordial Ones who had long been buried by history were collectively resurrected?

Stop joking, okay? Even a TV series would not dare to film this!

However, a few days later, as the Beyond Grade A Association members personally admitted the authenticity of the news, the entire galactic society was dumbfounded!

Was this really true?!

The historical figures in the textbooks came back to life?

If I'm not crazy, then the world is crazy!

The emotions of countless people exploded!

Driven by panic, fanaticism, and shock, the news spread faster and faster, and the galactic society that had been peaceful for decades was once again stirred up.

Be it ordinary people or Supers, civilizations or civil organizations, almost everyone vaguely saw a storm brewing rapidly, and they all had the same strong premonition.

This universe seemed to be about to undergo a great change!
